THE 2022 ECLIPSE CROSS > 01 PERFORMANCE
> PEAK PRECISION
The specifications of the front and rear suspension on the Eclipse
Cross have been optimized to deliver more agility and stability. A rigid
EXPLORE
connection, sized-up rear absorber and fine-tuned rebound spring
PERFORMANCE
allow the vehicle to respond to road conditions in real-time, offering
exceptional handling and a dramatically smoother ride overall.
Optional features shown. Available at additional cost. Visit mitsubishicars.com for more information.
